runs.scope: Only f0410fb15500 atomic CMPXCHG dword [R13+0],EDX at the original PC. Four genuine no-access/read-only RMW faults cover both would-match and would-mismatch inputs and remain failed operations. Full source-bound native/TF state comparisons and complete private records are retained. Prior suites remain separately required. Singleton profile; no split-lock, concurrent atomicity, real-program completion, performance or full-B2 qualification.
